items.title: Optimal approximate-counting bounds with trusted quantum samples, reflections and a QSampling unitary
items.author: Scott Aaronson; Robin Kothari; William Kretschmer; Justin Thaler
items.source_version: Official complete47-page CCC2020 CC BY3.0 Unported publication; mainTheorem4, matchedTheorem5 and detailedTheorem31 with entire Section4.1–4.4/4.6 and AppendixA proofs. Nonexclusive nativev3 private aid only.
items.difficulty_reason: The authors track positive and negative Laurent degrees for trusted quantum inputs, transform the approximation linear program to an ordinary-polynomial dual, glue positive- and negative-degree witnesses and control the delicate AppendixA product estimates to obtain the tight sample/reflection versus membership-query tradeoff.
